criteria.description: DNS catalog HTTP handler and handler tests are removed from internal/api/handlers.
RouterDeps no longer accepts DNSCatalog and /api/v1/dns/catalog, /api/v1/dns/catalog/{fqdn}, /api/v1/dns/zones, and /api/v1/dns/drift routes are not registered.
Application wiring no longer constructs or passes a DNS catalog REST handler.
Backend compiles after REST DNS catalog removal.
